title: A 18. század: újjáépítés és felvilágosodás összefoglalása (Unit 14 Consolidation)

sections.title: Consolidation Goals
items: I can synthesize 18th-century repopulation, Maria Theresa's reforms, and Joseph II's reign.
I can confidently answer Hungarian citizenship questions on Maria Theresa and the Enlightenment.
I can review the unit's vocabulary and use által, révén and -val/-vel.
